page.overview:
What is Isabella?

Isabella, also known as Two, is one of the overarching antagonists and twist deuteragonists in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series. She is one of the first-generation, also known as gen1, Bobbiedots.

Two, compared to the other broken gen1s, is far more ravaged and decrepit. She is just a stripped-down metal endoskeleton topped by a mutilated one-eyed skull. Two's lower jaw is broken, flopping to the side. She also has sharp metal fingers and a glowing green eye. Two’s cables are laid bare, with sparking copper wiring sprouting from the top of her mangled cranium. Her hip sockets are ragged as both limbs have been torn away, leaving her a stark metal torso and skull streaming exposed wires.

Two weeks after the gen1s are defeated, Abe manages to find new legs for Isabella and gets nearly enough pieces of plastic exoskeleton for Sasha to form an entirely new one for Isabella.

She was programmed with protecting the tenant and the tower back when they were active. When she and the other gen1 Bobbiedots heard that Landon Prout was planning on burning down the Fazplex Tower, they were frighted and decided to kill him which led them to being broken and decrepit.
